title: How to change cursor in ChatGPT on Mac: a guide for system pointer settings
metaTitle: How to change cursor in ChatGPT on Mac: Settings Guide
description: Learn how to change cursor on Mac to improve visibility in ChatGPT. Discover why the app uses system pointers and how to adjust your macOS settings.
targetKeyword: how to change cursor on mac
intro: You cannot change the cursor icon directly within the ChatGPT app because it uses your default macOS pointer. To adjust the cursor appearance, you must modify your system settings in macOS.
tldr: ChatGPT does not support custom cursor icons or styles.
The app uses the standard pointer defined by your macOS system settings.
You can change the size, outline color, and fill color in System Settings.
Third-party cursor software can change the pointer system-wide but not just for ChatGPT.
Avoid confusing the mouse cursor with the Cursor code editor app.

blocks.text: Why you cannot change the cursor inside ChatGPT

Many users want to customize their interface to make it more accessible or visually distinct. When you use the ChatGPT desktop app on your Mac, the software is designed to respect your operating system's global settings. This means it does not have an internal menu to swap the arrow for a different icon or a custom animation. If you see guides online claiming you can change the cursor specifically for ChatGPT, they are likely referring to browser extensions for the web version or external apps that do not interact with the official desktop client.

The ChatGPT app relies on the standard macOS framework for all interface elements. This ensures that the app feels native to your computer and behaves as expected when you move your mouse or trackpad. Because it uses the system cursor, any changes you make to your Mac's pointer settings will immediately reflect within the ChatGPT window.
How to change cursor on Mac system settings

Since you must change the cursor at the system level, you should focus on the Accessibility settings in macOS. These settings allow you to make the pointer larger or change its colors so it is easier to track while you are typing prompts or reading long responses in ChatGPT.

items: Open the Apple menu in the top left corner of your screen.
Select System Settings from the dropdown menu.
Click on Accessibility in the sidebar.
Look for the Pointer section to find your customization options.

blocks.text: Within this menu, you can adjust the pointer size by dragging the slider. You can also change the outline color and the fill color by clicking on the color swatches. If you often lose track of your cursor on a busy screen, enable the option to shake the mouse pointer to locate it. This makes the cursor grow temporarily when you move it quickly.
Avoiding confusion with the Cursor code editor

A common point of confusion arises because there is a popular AI-powered code editor called Cursor. Some users search for how to change the cursor in ChatGPT when they actually want to know how to integrate their ChatGPT account with the Cursor IDE. These are two separate pieces of software.

If you are trying to use ChatGPT to help you write code in the Cursor editor, you do not need to change your mouse pointer. Instead, you should look into the Work with Apps feature. This feature allows ChatGPT to read context from other applications on your Mac, including code editors. Ensure you have granted the necessary Accessibility permissions in System Settings under Privacy and Security so that ChatGPT can communicate with your other tools.

If you find that your mouse interactions feel sluggish inside the ChatGPT app, it might not be a cursor problem. It could be an issue with the app's cache or a conflict with other running processes. Try restarting the ChatGPT app first. If the problem persists, check for any background apps that might be intercepting mouse clicks or modifying your interface.
Using keyboard shortcuts to navigate ChatGPT

When you are working in ChatGPT, you might find that using the keyboard is more efficient than relying on the cursor at all. The Mac app comes with a variety of built-in shortcuts that help you move through the interface without needing to click specific buttons.

To see the full list of available shortcuts, open the ChatGPT app and press Command + /. This will display a window with all the default key combinations. You can also customize these by going to the app settings. If a specific keyboard command is not working, check if it conflicts with a global system shortcut.

faq.question: Can I use a custom cursor icon in ChatGPT?
faq.answer: No. ChatGPT uses the system-wide cursor defined by your macOS settings. It does not support custom icons or skins.

faq.question: Does changing my Mac cursor affect other apps?
faq.answer: Yes. When you change your cursor size or color in System Settings, the change applies to every application on your Mac, including ChatGPT.

faq.question: Is there a setting for cursor speed in ChatGPT?
faq.answer: No. Cursor speed is controlled by your Mac's Trackpad or Mouse settings, found in System Settings under the specific device category.

faq.question: Why does my cursor disappear in the ChatGPT app?
faq.answer: If your cursor disappears, it might be a temporary rendering issue. Try resizing the app window or restarting the ChatGPT application.

task: Change the cursor appearance for the ChatGPT app on a Mac.
appliesTo: ChatGPT desktop app for macOS (rebuilt July 2026).

steps.name: Open System Settings
steps.text: Click the Apple menu in the top left and select System Settings.

steps.name: Navigate to Accessibility
steps.text: Scroll down the left sidebar and click on Accessibility.

steps.name: Open Display Settings
steps.text: Click on the Display option within the Accessibility menu.

steps.name: Adjust Pointer Settings
steps.text: Find the Pointer section and move the slider to change the pointer size or change the colors.
steps.tip: Enable the shake to locate feature if you often lose your cursor.

troubleshooting.problem: Cursor changes are not showing in ChatGPT.
troubleshooting.fix: Restart the ChatGPT app to ensure it refreshes its interface settings.
Check Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts in the ChatGPT app to ensure they are not disabled.
